Japan’s 7th Strategic Energy Plan (Approved February 2025)
This is the core policy document, issued by the Cabinet and led by the Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI) / Agency for Natural Resources and Energy (ANRE). It sets targets for FY2040 while aiming for carbon neutrality by 2050:
Nuclear power: Target ~20% of electricity generation (up from ~8.5% in FY2023). The plan explicitly shifts from "reducing dependence as much as possible" (post-Fukushima language) to "maximizing" use.
